blurb: Plongée Nautilus is the largest sport diving company in the Quebec City region since 1998. They offer a comprehensive calendar of diving activities and trips, some requiring booking over a year in advance. Activities include diving with diverse marine life, exploring shipwrecks, and seasonal events like crab parties.
extraNote: Prices are before taxes · Shop at 1545 Boulevard Père-Lelièvre, Québec, or specific locations like Gîte du plongeur at 93, rte 138, Les Bergeronnes, or Flintkote at 1104 Rue Flintkote, Thetford Mines
